await ready('#pilotNewWorkspace');await open('#uiProjectDetails');await p.locator('#pilotNewWorkspace').click();await nav('items');if(!await p.locator('#itemIntake').isVisible())await p.locator('#toggleItemIntake').click();await p.locator('#importFile').setInputFiles(fixtures+'independent-items.xlsx');await ready('#confirmImportRows');await expect(p.locator('#importPreview tbody tr')).toHaveCount(12);await p.locator('#confirmImportRows').click();await check('setup twelve actual imported lines',(await snap()).state.items.length,12);global.wid=(await snap()).workspaceId;global.ids=(await snap()).state.items.map(x=>x.lineId);fs.writeFileSync(fixtures+'line-ids.json',JSON.stringify(ids));await check('same code different specifications separate identities',ids[0]!==ids[1],true);cp.execFileSync('python',['/tmp/pr46-cont/create-quote-file.py',fixtures+'line-ids.json','R1',fixtures+'A-R1.xlsx']);cp.execFileSync('python',['/tmp/pr46-cont/create-quote-file.py',fixtures+'line-ids.json','R2',fixtures+'A-R2.xlsx']);
